scientific_integrity: The stated theorem is supported by the complete finite-model proof and by reproducible bounded computations. Finite checks alone do not establish the universal quantifiers. The external historical-priority assessment is not independent.
scientific_limitations: Only finite colored permutations, an exhaustive disjoint palette with q at least two, and one-point quantifier-free terms through depth d at least one; no claim about arbitrary unary functions, first-order quantifier rank, or an elementary product for the optimizer count.
title: Sharp universal colored-permutation profiles and a de Bruijn circuit-partition census
